requirements.summary: Remove all Caffeine.ai branding and attribution from the footer in Layout.tsx while keeping the footer element intact
acceptanceCriteria: The site footer renders with no 'Made with Caffeine.ai' text visible
No anchor tag or link pointing to caffeine.ai or any related URL exists in the footer
The footer element itself remains present on all pages
No other Caffeine.ai branding appears anywhere in the footer HTML

file_operations.description: Remove all Caffeine.ai attribution content from the footer element including any text, links, or branding references. Keep the footer element structure intact with only the Campus Connect branding.
